differences.what: massing: the draft's 14.25 x 10 m box with a generic corner tower and flat-roofed bay is now the sheet's plan: the 7.8 x 9.25 m front block under its steep front gable, the round turret at the front's north corner, the south wing standing 4.15 m out from the south flank under its own south-facing gable, and the body and '2B'/'1B' ranges behind; the front's south corner prints at x 920 px as the photograph's, the wing's junction at x 1287 against 1275
the front gable: its apex prints at about x 505, y 75 px against the photograph's x 545, y 70 (0.4 m in place, under the bar), its three attic lights at x 440-690 px, y 485-660, as the photograph's

the turret: a half-round slate cone rising from the main eave over a round body through the second floor on a rounded apron, its light at x 200-285 px, as the photograph's; it is 2.4 m across against the trace's 2.8 m (0.2 m a side)

the turret's finial: the cone's top sheathed in a pale metal cap flaring to a lip about 0.5 m across under a short dark knob (y 242-330 px) is built as K08's turned finial on a plain zinc collar 0.2 m out, now that a half round's cone carries a finial on its apex (T-3634), and the cone is set at pitch 2.8 so its slate stops under the cap: the render's lip prints at y 330 against the photograph's 325 and its tip at y 235 against 247 (about 0.13 m high); the kit's collar runs a little past the apex where the photograph's cap closes on the knob

the arched porch: the render's round-headed doorway x 258-414 px under the turret matches the photograph's arch x 235-420 in place and height, but K01 cuts it as a door in a 0.45 m reveal; the photograph's arch opens on a porch with a small light in its north wall and the door at its south end (K01 builds an open porch behind an arch only behind a stone front's voussoirs)
the stoop: the photograph's flight climbs along the front from the north to the porch; the render's runs straight out from the door

the front's lights: the broad lights of both storeys at x 690-820 px and the second-floor light at x 410-505 px print in place; the principal floor's broad light is built 1.15 m wide (the contract's widest) against about 1.3 m, and its transom bar is not drawn

the narrow ground-floor light between the porch and the broad window (x 505-560 px, y 1150-1425) is built as a plain-headed light read off the camera on the principal storey (front_bays_by_storey "0", T-3634), 0.65 m across on the broad light's 2.30 m sill to 4.95 m: it prints at x 510-560 px, y 1155-1425 against the photograph's; the halftone's paler band across it at y 1230-1280 is read as its meeting rails, not drawn
the window heads: the render lays K09 stone hoods over the street lights where the halftone shows plain pale heads; the hood's projection is under the bar
the south flank's narrow light a storey 1.4 m behind the front corner prints at x 965-1005 px as the photograph's

the south wing: a light a storey in its west face and its south-west light, its eave and its slate gable print where the photograph's do; its lowest west light is built 2.8-4.3 m against the photograph's low broad light of small panes at 3.35-4.25 m (one row of sizes a storey on a K01 wing), within about half a metre
the south wing's cut south-west corner (the sheet's, about a metre) is built square; the photograph's south-west light sits on that corner

the stacks: the tall stack on the south flank and the stack behind the turret print in place; the third, on the ridge about 10.4 m back (x 1010-1090 px), is now built on the south wing's ridge (rear_wings stacks, T-3634), its north edge at x 1010 px as the photograph's and its cap at y 305 against about 310; from this camera its south half stands behind the tall stack, where the photograph's meets that stack's edge (about 0.3 m in plan, under the bar)
the gable's rakes: the render carries K01's coped wall gable with a pale coping; the photograph's slate runs a little past brick rakes. A trim difference under the bar

the gable's finial: the photograph's knob on a slender neck over the front gable's apex (y 30-75 px, about 0.45 m) is built as K01's shaped-gable finial, a turned spike 0.45 m tall and 0.16 m across (T-3634); its top prints at y 33 against y 30, and a spike's outline against a knob's is under the bar
the fence: the photograph's low picket fence before the south wing; the render's street line is K11's lowest boarded fence (1.2 m) with a walk gate. K11 draws no picket
colour: the halftone is monochrome; the red brick and grey slate are reconstructed
the north flank, the rear and the rear ranges are not in the picture

_how: verdict is unreviewed | differs | matches, set by whoever compared the side-by-side with the picture; each difference is {what, status: open | fixed | not shown | within tolerance | owner ruling} — open only if a street visitor would notice it (over about 1 ft, missing, mis-shaped, miscounted, wrong material or colour), else within tolerance (T-3153); owner ruling where the owner asked the build to depart from the picture (T-3236).
